- **Identity Confirmed via Three Independent Sources**: Marco de Baar (b. 1967) serves as Director of DIFFER (Dutch Institute for Fundamental Energy Research) since May 2020 with a second five-year term announced July 10, 2025, AND as part-time Full Professor and Chair of Plasma Fusion Operation and Control at TU/e's Mechanical Engineering Faculty -> The dual-hatted identity is verifiable, but the research group name in the lead input ("Science and Technology of Nuclear Fusion at TU/e") does not match the institutional record.
- **TU/e Research Group Mismatch is a Key Caveat**: TU/e's official profile places Marco de Baar in "Control Systems Technology" / Group Heemels within Mechanical Engineering, not a separate "Science and Technology of Nuclear Fusion" group -> Before treating the lead as accurate, downstream automations should verify via PURE/TU/e records rather than the FRMG/Fusenet label.
- **DIFFER Plasma Edge Physics and Diagnostics Has a Different Group Leader**: Ivo Classen (i.g.j.classen@differ.nl) leads the "Plasma Edge Physics and Diagnostics" group at DIFFER, with team members Mark Cornelissen, Chris Lee, Kay Schutjes, Koen Tolkamp, Tijs Wijkamp, and Michael Winder -> Postings tied to "Plasma Edge Physics and Diagnostics" should be attributed to Ivo Classen, not Marco de Baar, unless a posting explicitly names him.
- **EUROfusion 2026 Cycle Grants (announced Nov 18, 2025) Did Not Go to Marco de Baar Personally**: Of 23 grants awarded (9 ERG + 14 EEG), only one DIFFER researcher (Stefan Dasbach, "Physics-constrained deep learning models for power plant scale exhaust") is named -> This is the only DIFFER-side Horizon/EURATOM-linked competitive award I could verify for the 2026 cycle; Marco de Baar is not listed as PI.
- **Two DIFFER Postings Surface for 2026 Cycle on Sub-aggregator Sites, Not on the Official Portal**: (1) "PhD Position in Plasma Edge Physics and Diagnostics at DIFFER" on ApplyKite, posted ~2 days before the aggregator scraped it; (2) "Post-doctoral researcher Digital Twins for the plasma edge in tokamaks" on Academic Positions, dated 2026 -> Both lack confirmed contact with Marco de Baar; PRIMARY official DIFFER vacancies page lists no individual openings.
- **Director Appointment is Institutional, Not Competitive Grant Funding**: NWO-I's July 10, 2025 reappointment to a second 5-year term as DIFFER director is an institutional leadership mandate -> It is NOT a competitive research grant, so it should not be counted in the "funding" tally; the public amount is not disclosed.
- **No Personal NWO Vidi/Vici/ERC Award Verified for Marco de Baar 2024-2026**: NWO and CORDIS searches surfaced no Vidi/Vici/ERC/individual Horizon Europe grant personally awarded to him during the scope window -> "No verified public evidence found" is the appropriate label for personal PI grants; the gap is explicit, not inferred.
